VI.description: Finds a window through user32.dll FindWindowExW (stdcall\2C called in any thread)\3A the next child of hWndParent after hWndChildAfter in Z order whose class and title match. With hWndParent 0 it walks the TOP-LEVEL windows\2C so calling it repeatedly with the previous answer as hWndChildAfter enumerates them without a callback. lpszClass and lpszWindow are UTF-16 code units WITH a terminating 0; an EMPTY array passes NULL\2C which matches any class or title. hWnd is 0 when no further window matches. When error in carries an error the DLL is not called. Generated by scripts\5CBuild Win32 Wrappers.vi - do not edit by hand\2C rebuild it.
